How much life can you find in black?

@EmilHeliot , the Copenhagen-born global fashion brand, just released their new Core Uniform collection campaign film, directed by UNVEIL, creative direction by Julius Juul, made with Kling 4.0.

It's a study in black, the same color reinterpreted again and again, but none of it feels flat. Shadows with depth, fabric that catches the light, faces that say a lot without speaking.

“Kling 4.0 brings together two things we value: serendipity and control.” Build the world first, then let the film happen inside it. - Tom-Jacques Perret, co-founder of UNVEIL. #Kling4 #KlingAI
